lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb2Zn4S4Br4 (reduced formula Rb(ZnSBr)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all four centers: Br and S each have four Zn neighbors, while Zn has four neighbors (two Br and two S), and Rb has four S neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Br tetrahedra and Zn tetrahedra and between Zn tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic neighbor graph.
